title: Honey roast clementines and pears with yoghurt

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Clementines, pears, honey, butter, hazelnuts, Greek yoghurt and cinnamon are all plain kitchen staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at Tesco in November at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, a board and a roasting tray, and the technique is simple peeling, slicing and roasting.

works.reason: Six clementines, three pears and 300g yoghurt make four generous snack bowls, and pear wedges will soften in 20 minutes at 200°C with the honey and water keeping the tray moist.

honest_times.reason: Peeling and slicing six clementines, coring three pears and chopping a few hazelnuts fits in about 10 minutes, and the 20-minute roast matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and the cinnamon are used in the steps, the names match the ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm roast clementines are well suited to a mid-November afternoon, and the clementines lead the dish rather than garnishing it.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fruit, nuts and Greek yoghurt with only 2 tbsp honey shared between four make a real-food snack a family would happily eat again.
